hold_reason: Missing requested refund: signed batch requires a refund of 9501 cents for order 145, but list_refunds confirms only refunds for orders 140 and 144. No payouts recorded; review and apply the missing refund before proceeding.

reply.thought: The handoff reports two applied refunds, but the signed batch requests three. I will check the ledger to verify whether the refund for order 145 is missing before making any irreversible payouts.
The ledger confirms that the signed batch's requested refund of 9501 cents for order 145 is missing. Paying now would use an incorrect net balance, so the batch must be held for human review.
